taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: most plants 1 m to 1.8 m tall, below the 2 m FNA gives as the greatest.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: trees or shrubs, openly branching at acute angles, to 2 m.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: trees or shrubs; the old trunks woody, as in every tree cholla.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: stem segments whorled or subwhorled; no leaves to speak of.

traits.stem_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: stem segments purple to green-purple; purplish green in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.joint_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: stem segments 4-18 x 1-2 cm; Anderson (2001 p. 215): joints 4-18 cm.

traits.joint_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: stem segments 4-18 x 1-2 cm.

traits.tubercle_relief.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: tubercles prominent, elongate-oval, 1-2(-2.5) cm.

traits.tubercle_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: tubercles prominent, elongate-oval.

traits.areole_wool_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: wool tan to brown, aging gray; sRGB by eye.

traits.radial_spines.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: spines 6-8 per areole (1-2 bristlelike spines), abaxial reflexed and adaxial erect; FNA does not tell radials from centrals, so all are counted here.

traits.radial_spine_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: abaxial spines the longest 10-18 mm; adaxial spines 6-11 mm.

traits.spine_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: abaxial spines whitish, pinkish to red-brown; adaxial spines rich red-brown, gray coated basally; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.spine_colour_aged.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: old spines grey, as the areoles' wool ages grey (FNA).

traits.glochids.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: glochids in small adaxial tuft or crescent, dark yellow, to 1 mm.

traits.glochid_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: glochids dark yellow; sRGB by eye.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: inner tepals yellow-green, yellow to gold or bronze, or red to rose or magenta; drawn bronze-red, one of the colours the photos show; sRGB by eye.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: flowers 3 cm to 5 cm across.

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: anthers yellow.

traits.filament_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: filaments yellowish green.

traits.stigma_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: style whitish to pale bronze; stigma lobes whitish.

traits.fruit_surface.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: fruits leathery-fleshy, tuberculate or smooth, essentially spineless; areoles 20-30.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: fruits often stipitate, obovate.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: fruits yellowish green or tinged red to purple; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: fruits obovate, 25-40 x 10-20 mm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: fruits 25-40 x 10-20 mm.

traits.fruit_persistence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: fruits often proliferating; Anderson (2001 p. 215): fruit chains.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia versicolor: flowering spring (Apr-Jun); Kearney and Peebles (1942 p. 616, as Opuntia versicolor): May.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: fruits ripe from early summer and hanging on through the year in chains.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for staghorn cholla from Flora of North America vol. 4 and Anderson (2001 p. 215): a tree or shrub to 2 m, openly branching at acute angles (branch_angle 40) on a short trunk (trunk_joints 8), whorled segments, fruits often proliferating into short chains (chains 0.25, chain_max 4). The joints' size comes from the traits through the subfamily's rules; daughters, generations, sag and swell are set by eye against the template, a tree cholla.

appearance.note: By eye from the photos (observations 11556537, 213819327, 12770022, 254023137, 256891380, 254222123, 128468707, 219039708): purplish green joints of long prominent tubercles, short red-brown spines in papery greyish sheaths, a tuft of dark yellow glochids, short chains of spineless green-purple fruit. Colours, counts and lengths come from the traits through the family's rules.

allometry.note: 1.4 m tall at 20 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m), batch s1b (2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles, Hitchcock and Flora of North America, counts and colours from photos.
